period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2012 (Unaudited)", filename 'First Quarterly Report.pdf' retrieved via Wayback Machine), not a later annual-report retrospective table. The document contains both a 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' and a separate, unlabelled 'Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2012' (Solo/Standalone) plus matching Consolidated and Solo Profit and Loss Accounts; per project convention the SOLO figures are used here. Cross-check: this document's Solo Balance Sheet comparative column for 31-Dec-2011 (Total assets 115,735,967,684) matches the dataset's existing 2011_Q4 total_assets (115,736m) almost exactly, confirming 2011_Q4 is on a Solo basis consistent with this quarter. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is not a line item in the primary statement; it is calculated here as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported), matching the definition implied by the annual-report-embedded 'Quarterly Performance' table used for 2022+ quarters (Total operating income - Net interest income - Investment income reconciles exactly to this sum). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement (unlike the annual-report quarterly table used for 2022-2025) and is left out as a genuine gap rather than back-calculated.
